title: 超越记忆：基于模板的异构协作知识工作与LLM代理
summary: 提出llm-wiki-memory-template，一种可复用的、代理感知的实例化模板，通过在原始来源和代理之间插入LLM维护的互连维基，解决研究项目中知识丢失和负面结果损失问题。支持多人类、多AI代理、多领域三个维度的异构协作，并通过三个部署案例和一个设计报告验证其有效性。
summary_en: Proposes llm-wiki-memory-template, a reusable agent-aware instantiation that inserts an LLM-maintained interlinked wiki between raw sources and agents to address knowledge loss and negative-result loss in research projects. Supports heterogeneous collaboration across multi-human, multi-AI-agent, and multi-domain axes, validated through three deployed case studies and one design report.
